arena: [생존기] Icebound Fortitude makes you immune to stuns and reduces damage taken by 30% for 8 sec. Use it when the enemy stuns you and starts their burst.

[생존기] Anti-Magic Shell absorbs magic damage and prevents harmful magic effects for 5 sec. With Spellwarden you can also cast it on allies and its cooldown drops by 10 sec, so time it to magic CC casts aimed at teammates.
[해제] Lichborne makes you immune to charm, fear and sleep for 10 sec. Pop it early when you see the enemy casting a fear.
[차단] Mind Freeze interrupts a cast within 15 yds and locks that school for 5 sec. Save it for the enemy healer's heals.
[제어] Asphyxiate stuns a target within 20 yds for 5 sec. Lock down the enemy healer when your team bursts.
[제어] Death Grip pulls the target to you, but its cooldown is 10 sec longer in PvP combat. Save it to pull an enemy healer out from behind a pillar.
[생존기] Last Dance cuts Dancing Rune Weapon's cooldown by 50% and its duration by 25%. Use it often for 30% parry every time a melee DPS bursts.
[광역 피해] With Decomposing Aura, enemies within 8 yds lose up to 3% of max health every 2 sec. Fight stacked next to multiple enemies.
bg: [참고] In Battleground Blitz there are 0-1 tanks, and slow tanks need help carrying the flag. Create your own distance with Death's Advance (10 sec slow and knockback immunity) and Wraith Walk's root break.
[제어] Gorefiend's Grasp pulls all enemies within 15 yds of the target to the target's location and silences them for 3 sec. Group up enemies gathered to capture a base and shut them down.

[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Use Vampiric Blood (+30% healing and absorbs taken) early in a focus; with Bloodforged Armor, Death Strike reduces physical damage taken by 25% for 4 sec.
[분담] Anti-Magic Zone reduces party and raid members' magic damage taken by 15% for 6 sec. Drop it when allies stacked on base defense take magic AoE damage.
[위치] Chains of Ice slows the target by 70% for 8 sec and Death Grip pulls it in. Hold the enemy flag carrier on your team's side.
pvpTalents: Last Dance, picked by all top 23 Solo Shuffle players and 35 of 40 Battleground Blitz players, halves Dancing Rune Weapon's cooldown. Decomposing Aura, picked by 19 of 23 Solo Shuffle and 28 of 40 Battleground Blitz players, drains max health from enemies within 8 yds every 2 sec. Spellwarden, picked by 18 of 23 Solo Shuffle players, lets you cast Anti-Magic Shell on allies.
